correctness.rationale: The parity argument forces independence for sets of size at least three. The full affine-incidence distance table gives the exact forbidden configuration: two parallel selected lines and a transversal. Parallel and one-per-direction line families yield separate sharp union bounds; the odd-projective-order pairing argument excludes the only competing equality at q=3. All q=2 and q=3 cases are independently exhaustively enumerated using actual included source programs.

value.rationale: The first mixed degree of the general-position polynomial is a motivated extremal invariant: it quantifies how far a graph-geodesic configuration must drop from the entire point shore before containing any line. Uniform non-Desarguesian validity, the unique maximum, exact first mixed coefficient and the small-order phase exception are structural rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
